name: CV / Resume Analysis - Technical Writer
description: Extraction rules and signal mappings for Technical Writer CVs/resumes, focusing on published documentation portals, API references, content strategy audits, style guide governance, and support ticket deflection metrics.

quality_indicators: Demonstrated authorship of public developer portals and REST/GraphQL API reference docs
Measurable support ticket deflection metrics (e.g., 'reduced API-related support tickets by 40% through interactive quickstarts')
Creation and leadership of organizational technical style guides and Vale linter automation
Implementation of Docs-as-Code CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Docusaurus, MkDocs)
Cross-functional collaboration with engineering SMEs to document complex distributed architectures
Multi-version documentation management and internationalization (Crowdin, Lokalise)
Live links to public developer documentation hubs (e.g., docs.company.com)
Published technical articles on Medium, Dev.to, Hashnode, or engineering blogs
Public GitHub repositories showcasing Docs-as-Code workflows, Markdown/MDX, and OpenAPI YAML files
Published whitepapers, ebooks, case studies, or Keep a Changelog release notes

skills_list.notes: Technical writing skills listed without concrete deliverable context receive lower baseline strength.

recognized_certifications: Society for Technical Communication (STC) Certified Professional Technical Communicator (CPTC)
AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner / Solutions Architect (Demonstrating technical domain depth)

patterns.pattern: Authored and maintained comprehensive technical documentation, adhering to Google/Microsoft style guides with active voice and high readability
Conducted SME interviews with software engineers, parsed PRDs and code diffs, performed content gap analysis and single-sourcing audits
Authored REST/GraphQL/gRPC API reference documentation, OpenAPI 3.0 YAML schemas, multi-language code snippets, quickstarts, and SDK guides
Authored procedural how-to guides, Keep a Changelog release notes, FAQ articles, diagnostic troubleshooting runbooks, and admin manuals
Wrote technical blog posts, whitepapers, customer migration case studies, optimized doc SEO metadata, and tracked organic traffic growth
Implemented Docs-as-Code tooling, Docusaurus/MkDocs SSGs, Vale/markdownlint automated CI/CD, Algolia search, and doc analytics telemetry
